title: Bound on an integer sum
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a type, let $l$ be a finite list in $\alpha$, let $f:\alpha\to\mathbb{Z}$, and let $B\in\mathbb{Z}$. If $|f(x)|\le B$ for every entry $x$ of $l$, then the absolute value of the sum of the values $f(x)$ over the list is at most $\operatorname{length}(l)B$.
